Precipitation (rain/snow) was erroneously subtracted in reconstruction of SGS *cloud* condensate, violating condensate conservation in the quadratures. 

This PR fixes this and adds tests to make sure mid point equals grid mean.
title: Fixes microphysics/cloud fraction bug: erroneous subtraction of precip i

body:
- Fit `λ_lagrange` to the discrete quadrature constraint `Σᵢ wᵢ·max(0, λ + α·S′ᵢ) = q_c`  instead of the continuous Gaussian; the condensate mass constraint was previously violated by −15% to +160% (worst for thin clouds, q_c ≲ 0.1·σ_S); now it holds to machine precision.
- Add a second Newton step to `_compute_z`, removing a one-sided thin-cloud CF overestimate.
- 0M: return the flux-weighted energy helper E[dq_tot·e]/E[dq], so the precipitation energy sink is the true SGS average that takes covariances between `dq_tot/dt` and `e_tot` (was off by up to +56% in mixed regions, leading to warm bias near and above the melting layer).
- Adds regression tests across regimes, quadrature orders, and precisions.
title: Make the SGS quadrature closure more self-consistent:

body:
# CloudSat simulator

Simulator for the 94 GHz CloudSat Cloud Profiling Radar (CPR) following COSPv2. At each callback, the model samples grid-mean cloud and precipitation into subcolumns using the configured overlap assumption. For each subcolumn, the simulator:

1. distributes cloud liquid, cloud ice, rain, and snow from the 1M microphysics scheme
2. diagnoses particle sizes using the 1M particle-size distributions
3. computes hydrometeor backscatter and extinction, together with atmospheric gas attenuation
4. integrates two-way attenuation downward from the model top
5. calculate total cloud cover and CFAD

## Configuration

The simulator is enabled by assigning a finite value to `dt_subcol`. It currently produces CloudSat diagnostics only with the 1M microphysics scheme.

```yaml
microphysics_model: "1M"

dt_subcol: "10mins"
cosp_n_subcolumns: 100
cosp_overlap: "maximum_random"

diagnostics:
  - short_name: [cloudsat_tcc, cloudsat_tcc2]
    period: "10mins"
title: Wu/cloudsat simulator
